description: This file defines the TransactionFactoryLoader class, which loads and provides access to a singleton instance of TransactionFactory based on configuration, using reflection to instantiate the class.

classes.name: TransactionFactoryLoader
classes.description: Utility class for loading and providing singleton access to the TransactionFactory instance.

methods.name: createTransactionFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of TransactionFactory based on class name from configuration, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton TransactionFactory instance, throwing if not initialized.
